Pushing the boundaries of global knowledge
Whether you’re driven by curiosity or a desire to address real-world challenges, our postgraduate research opportunities will enable you to advance your passions and make an impact.
As a postgraduate research student at Newcastle, you’ll engage in independent research under the guidance of experienced supervisors, and with the support of our Doctoral College. You’ll develop the sought-after expertise and high-level skills prized by employers.
Make discoveries that matter
Top 65 in the world for research quality (Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026)
Build expertise for your future
5 QS Stars (2025) for student employability
Thrive in a top, affordable city
World top 50 and UK top 5 (QS Best Student Cities 2027)
Your research degree options
There's more than one way to start your postgraduate research journey at Newcastle. We offer PhDs, Professional Doctorates and Integrated PhDs. We also offer Research Master's degrees.
For PhD study you can apply for a funded studentship, with a defined research topic and secured funding. Or you can propose your own research idea and apply with a research proposal. Both routes give you the opportunity to become an expert in your field and make a real impact with your research.
A Research Master's provides a more research-focused route to a Master's degree. You'll develop independent research skills and expertise in your chosen subject. If you're considering a PhD in the future, a Research Master's is excellent preparation, giving you valuable experience and insight into advanced academic research.

Research that matters
Whether you’re passionate about advancing healthcare, responding to climate change, or exploring the intersections of culture and society, at Newcastle you’ll join a supportive research-focused environment.
We're geared towards academic discovery and personal growth. Our research culture supports collaboration and the freedom to grow and explore. Join a community centred around fairness, inclusion, openness and integrity.

We're here to support you
From dedicated academic supervisors to professional development programmes, we're with you throughout your research journey.
Introducing the Doctoral College
Our Doctoral College provides dedicated support and guidance to our postgraduate research community. We cover a wide range of research orientated activities – including funding.
The College provides you with opportunities to:
enhance your research experience
develop your academic profile by presenting at key conferences in your field
enhance your networking skills
develop your career prospects
You’ll become a member of our Doctoral College when you enrol.
